title: SS27 Toddler Girls' Formalwear Styling
summary: Occasion toddler girls: smocked dresses and bloomers.
research_period: Pitti Bimbo 103, Florence, 24-25 June 2026; Playtime Paris, 28-30 June 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Premium and mid-market childrenswear, Europe-led fairs, global retail

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: - Fatamadrina lists oversized florals, checks with fruit prints, paisley, vintage geometrics, nautical themes and gingham, and "Wildflowers Bloom" with delicate handcrafted embroidery<sup>[1]</sup>

design_implications:
- Soft linings.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.

sources.title: Childrenswear fashion trends and forecast S/S 2027
sources.note: Design studio forecast; used for season-wide fabric, silhouette and print notes
